Bobsled race |region=Orange Islands |battlefield=Navel Gym Battlefield.png |colordark=61ae43 |colorlight=b1edb7 }} The '''Navel Gym''' (Japanese: '''ネーブルジム''' ''Navel Gym'') is the official [[Gym]] of [[Navel Island]]. The [[Gym Leader]] is [[Danny]]. {{pkmn|Trainer}}s who meet his challenges receive the {{Badge|Sea Ruby}}. ==In animation== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== ===={{aniseries|OS}}==== The Navel Gym made its only appearance in the ''Pokémon the Series: The Beginning'' episode ''[[EP093|Navel Maneuvers]]''. The Navel Gym isn't a building and instead spans the entire mountain on Navel Island. Unlike most Gyms, there is no [[Pokémon battle|battling]] involved at this Gym. Instead, Danny makes Trainers participate in several mountaineering challenges, including scaling the mountain without the aid of any {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} as an entrance test before the actual rounds begin, lest they be disqualified. To win the coveted Sea Ruby Badge, a challenger must win in two of three of the following speed tests. In the first round, a challenger must freeze a natural geyser the fastest. Next, the ice made from freezing the geyser water must be crafted into bobsleds, with each side using three Pokémon to accomplish this in another test of speed. Finally, in the third round, the Gym Leader and challenger race down the mountain in their newly-constructed bobsleds with the aid of three Pokémon each for avoiding obstacles and enhancing speed. ====Pokémon used in the Gym==== {{TrainerPoké |width=70 |trainer=Danny |pkmn=Nidoqueen |gender=female |type1=Poison |type2=Ground |img=Danny Nidoqueen.png |epnum=EP093 |epname=Navel Maneuvers |desc=Danny's {{p|Nidoqueen}} was used by him in the first challenge against Ash. Using Ice Beam, she was able to quickly freeze the water coming out of the geyser in order to beat {{AP|Lapras}}. Nidoqueen's physical strength was then used to help carve out a sled from Danny's slab of ice in the second challenge. She reappeared in flashbacks in ''[[EP098|A Way Off Day Off]]'' and ''[[EP111|Hello, Pummelo!]]''. Nidoqueen's only known move is {{m|Ice Beam}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Danny |pkmn=Machoke |type1=Fighting |img=Danny Machoke.png |epnum=EP093 |epname=Navel Maneuvers |vaen=Eric Stuart |desc=Danny's {{p|Machoke}} was only seen in the second challenge against Ash, where it helped to carve a sled from the ice that Nidoqueen froze earlier. It reappeared in a flashback in ''[[EP111|Hello, Pummelo!]]''. None of Machoke's moves are known.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Danny |pkmn=Scyther |type1=Bug |type2=Flying |img=Danny Scyther.png |epnum=EP093 |epname=Navel Maneuvers |vaen=Eric Stuart |desc={{p|Scyther}} was the only one of Danny's Pokémon to be in both the second and third challenges. It first helped carve the block ice into a sled after which it then helped steer that sled in the race down the mountain. It reappeared in flashbacks in ''[[EP098|A Way Off Day Off]]'' and ''[[EP111|Hello, Pummelo!]]''. None of Scyther's moves are known.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Danny |pkmn=Electrode |type1=Electric |img=Danny Electrode.png |epnum=EP093 |epname=Navel Maneuvers |vaen=Eric Stuart |desc={{p|Electrode}} was one of Danny's Pokémon that was used in the third challenge, the race down the mountain. It used its weight to help steer and it also used Explosion to ward off Team Rocket. It reappeared in flashbacks in ''[[EP098|A Way Off Day Off]]'' and ''[[EP111|Hello, Pummelo!]]''. Electrode's only known move is {{m|Explosion}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Danny |pkmn=Geodude |type1=Rock |type2=Ground |img=Danny Geodude.png |epnum=EP093 |epname=Navel Maneuvers |vaen=Michael Haigney |desc={{p|Geodude}} was only seen during the race down the mountain. Besides using its weight to help steer the sled, Geodude also had a powerful throw in the snowball fight to defend against Team Rocket. It reappeared in flashbacks in ''[[EP098|A Way Off Day Off]]'' and ''[[EP111|Hello, Pummelo!]]''. None of Geodude's moves are known.}} ==In the manga== [[File:Navel Gym EToP.png|thumb|230px|Navel Gym in [[The Electric Tale of Pikachu]]]] ===The Electric Tale of Pikachu=== The Navel Gym made a brief cameo appearance in ''[[ET16|You Bet Your Wife]]'', where {{OBP|Ash Ketchum|EToP|Ash}} was seen exiting the Gym, having just won himself his third [[Orange League]] [[Badge|Gym Badge]]. {{-}} ==Trivia== * Navel Gym is the only known Gym without a battlefield. ==Related articles== {{Gym Leaders of the Orange Islands}} {{Project Anime notice|loc}} [[Category:Gyms]] [[Category:Orange Islands Gyms]] [[es:Gimnasio Pokémon de Isla Ombligo/Navel]] [[it:Palestra dell'Isola Navel]] [[zh:奈普鲁道馆]]
